card.desc:
## Lore:

**“I’m going to turn you into a pin-cushion!”**

**The Stand of Jean Pierre Polnareff. An armored, humanoid Stand that wields a rapier with masterful skill. It is highly agile and can shed its heavy silver armor to move at blinding speeds, creating afterimages to confuse opponents.**

## M1 Light Combo & M2 Attack

![silverchariotm1s.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432b9a5e54ed1c85bcb19/attachments/6ab5599ac1788e2cdac42ef6/previews/6ab559a5c1788e2cdac430ba/download/silverchariotm1s.gif)

## Rapier Rush

**A lightning-fast series of rapier thrusts.**

**Base cooldown: 23s**

![barrages.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432b9a5e54ed1c85bcb19/attachments/6ab558f536c78fb0553de0ce/previews/6ab5590136c78fb0553e017b/download/barrages.gif)

## Blade Eject

**Launch the blade from its hilt as a high-speed projectile. (Can Ricochet)**

**User cannot use any stand abilities without their rapier.**

**User can take their rapier back to avoid waiting for it to return.**

**Base cooldown: 30s**

![rapier.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432b9a5e54ed1c85bcb19/attachments/6ab559f7cd171351b7ee553f/previews/6ab559fdcd171351b7ee5ca2/download/rapier.gif)

## Your Last Moments

**Deliver a heavy strike that finishes off weakened enemies.**

**Base cooldown: 34s**

## French Rotation

**Silver Chariot spins and cuts everything around it, knocking enemies away with Bleed and breaking a blocking guard, unless perfect blocked. Use while stunned it breaks the stun and winds up longer.**

**Ability scaling: Damage scales 80% with Strength and 20% with Ability.**

**Base cooldown: 20s**

![base.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6af25325efcf475a0337cd99/attachments/6af8ab5fac35da881ba37be1/previews/6af8ab62ac35da881ba37f46/download/base.gif)

# EX [Awakening Moves]

## Stand Jump [1 Bar]

**Use your Stand’s power to launch high into the air.**

![standjump.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab432b9a5e54ed1c85bcb19/attachments/6ab55ddcf7ed88140eea888e/previews/6ab55de5f7ed88140eea972e/download/standjump.gif)

## Armor Toggle [1 Bar]

**Spend one EX bar to remove Silver Chariot’s armor for faster attacks, with EX draining slowly while it is off, and use it again to put the armor back on.**

**Armor Toggle trades protection and speed. (Armor off also gives you bigger hitboxes)**

**Base cooldown: 20s**

![armor.gif](https://trello.com/1/cards/6af25325efcf475a0337cd99/attachments/6af8abd33cc53c94664f4db1/previews/6af8abd73cc53c94664f54f1/download/armor.gif)
